title: TAIP Tuning Benchmark Suite v1
description: TRIBUNUS-ASYNC-INFERENCE-PROFILE dual-plane tuning evaluation schema. Every model-machine-profile-workload tuple that graduates as a selected ExecutionProfile must have passed both a performance plane and an intelligence plane. Neither plane may override the other. A fast-but-unusable model is Rejected. A smart-but-too-slow model is Quarantined for specific workloads only.

WorkloadClass.description: Semantic workload shape. Tuning outcomes are scoped to the workload class — a batch-optimized profile is not automatically optimal for short chat.

CachePolicy.description: KV cache strategy used during the benchmark. Maps to OMLX's SSD-backed KV cache and prefix-restoration features.

WorkloadDescriptor.description: The exact workload shape this tuning suite evaluated. Tuning is always tuple-bound: model × machine × profile × workload.

avg_context_tokens.description: Average context window length in tokens for this workload

concurrency_level.description: Number of concurrent inference requests (1 = single-agent)

streaming_required.description: Whether streaming token output was required

tool_call_budget_per_turn.description: Maximum tool calls allowed per turn (0 = no tool calls)

PerformanceMetricSet.description: Phase-level performance metrics. Every metric is anchored to a TAIP PhaseKind so regressions can be attributed to a specific phase. All latencies are in nanoseconds. All memory values are in bytes.

decode_tps.description: Sustained decode throughput in tokens per second

kv_view_copy_cost_bytes.description: Bytes copied during KvView phase (0 = zero-copy confirmed)

ssd_cache_hit_rate.description: Fraction of KV cache requests satisfied from SSD tier (OMLX SSD-KV dimension)

warm_vs_cold_cache_delta_tps.description: Decode TPS improvement when cache is warm vs. cold (OMLX prefix-restoration dimension)

thermal_degradation_pct.description: Decode TPS reduction under sustained load due to thermal throttling (observable only; None if not measured)

concurrency_scaling_efficiency.description: Throughput at concurrency_level N divided by N × throughput at concurrency 1. 1.0 = perfect linear scaling. (OMLX continuous-batching dimension)

MetricDelta.description: Comparison of a single metric between the tuning candidate and the baseline.

delta_pct.description: Signed percentage change from baseline. Negative = improvement for latency metrics; positive = improvement for throughput metrics.

direction.description: Whether the delta is an improvement, regression, or within noise floor

protected.description: True if this metric is in the acceptance policy protected set. A protected regression triggers Quarantine or Rejection.

PerformanceBenchmarkSpec.description: Specification for a single performance benchmark run.

phase_kind.description: TAIP PhaseKind this benchmark targets. cross_phase = aggregate metric.

target_metrics.description: Metric names from PerformanceMetricSet this spec measures

repetitions.description: Number of runs for stability estimation

PerformanceBenchmarkReceipt.description: Result of a single performance benchmark run.

TribunusNativeEvalKind.description: Tribunus project-native evals. First-class — not afterthoughts. These evals verify that the tuned model preserves agent competence on the actual tasks Tribunus executes.

IntelligenceBenchmarkSpec.description: Specification for a single intelligence evaluation.

prompt_template.description: Eval prompt template. May reference variables.

expected_schema.description: JSON Schema the output must validate against (if applicable)

fixed_seed.description: RNG seed for determinism testing. None = non-deterministic eval.

IntelligenceBenchmarkReceipt.description: Result of a single intelligence evaluation run.

score_breakdown.description: Per-subtask scores keyed by subtask name

determinism_verified.description: True if fixed-seed runs produced identical outputs across all repetitions

HardGate.description: A gate that must pass or the tuning candidate is Rejected immediately, regardless of all other scores.

params.description: Kind-specific parameters. For deterministic_replay: {seed: integer}. For minimum_intelligence_score: {threshold: number}.

ProtectedMetricGuard.description: A performance metric that cannot regress beyond threshold without triggering Quarantine.

regression_threshold_pct.description: Allowed regression as a percentage of baseline (e.g. 10.0 = 10%). Exceeding this triggers Quarantine.

gate_class.description: hard = Rejected if exceeded; soft = Quarantined if exceeded

TargetMetricSpec.description: A metric the tuning candidate must improve vs. baseline. Candidate must improve at least one target metric to be Promoted.

improvement_direction.description: lower_is_better for latency/memory; higher_is_better for throughput/scores

min_improvement_pct.description: Minimum percentage improvement required to count as an improvement (noise floor)

TuningAcceptancePolicy.description: The contract that controls whether a tuning candidate is Promoted, Quarantined, or Rejected. Both planes must meet their floors. Neither plane can override the other.

hard_gates.description: All must pass or the candidate is Rejected immediately

protected_metrics.description: Regressions beyond threshold trigger Quarantine or Rejection

target_metrics.description: Candidate must improve at least one target metric to be Promoted

min_intelligence_score.description: Minimum aggregate intelligence score (0.0–1.0). Failure = Rejected.

min_performance_score.description: Minimum composite performance score vs. baseline. Failure = Rejected.

stability_runs.description: Number of repeated runs required for score stability verification

BaselineProfileRef.description: Reference to the previously Promoted ExecutionProfile used as comparison baseline.

oneOf.description: Candidate improved at least one target metric, passed all hard gates, and both planes met their floors. Becomes the selected ExecutionProfile.
Candidate is useful for specific workloads but cannot become the default profile. A quarantined profile may still be selected for its declared workload_fit classes.

workload_fit.description: Workload classes this profile is still acceptable for, despite not being Promoted

oneOf.description: Candidate violated a hard gate or regressed a hard-class protected metric. Cannot be selected for any workload.

TuningLoopState.description: Ordered state machine for the tuning loop. Intelligence always runs after performance — never skipped.

TuningBenchmarkReceipt.description: A completed benchmark run receipt. May be either a PerformanceBenchmarkReceipt or IntelligenceBenchmarkReceipt, discriminated by receipt_kind.

suite_id.description: Unique identifier for this TuningBenchmarkSuite instance

model_profile_digest.description: Digest of the ModelProfile this suite evaluates. Together with machine and execution digests, forms the tuple identity.

machine_profile_digest.description: Digest of the MachineProfile this suite ran on

execution_profile_digest.description: Digest of the ExecutionProfile (phase graph + backend contracts) this suite evaluated

workload_descriptor.description: The workload shape this suite was evaluated under. A profile promoted under one workload is NOT automatically promoted under another.

intelligence_benchmarks.description: Task-oriented intelligence evaluation specifications. Must include at least one TribunusNativeEvalKind.

comparison_baseline.description: Baseline to compare against. Null = this is the first run and becomes the baseline on Promotion.

suite_status.description: Current lifecycle state of this suite

tuning_loop_state.description: Ordered state machine position. Intelligence cannot proceed before performance is complete.

benchmark_receipts.description: Append-only list of completed benchmark receipts. Never modified after append.

tuning_outcome.description: Final outcome. Null until OutcomeDetermined state is reached.

schema_notes.description: Free-form notes about this suite instance (e.g. OMLX comparison context, Apple Core AI SDK version)
